candidates.reason: Prospective continuation calibration using SCBench's official default pass policy so partial earlier checkpoints do not prevent observation of the target checkpoint.

protocol_amendment.failure: Checkpoint 2 scored 3/9 Core and the hard-coded all-core-cases gate stopped the native run before checkpoint 3. The reported clean checkpoint-3 score therefore evaluated a checkpoint-2 snapshot and is not a checkpoint-3 agent attempt.
protocol_amendment.repair: Set infer-problem pass_policy to the documented official default 'any'. This changes only checkpoint progression; all tests, evaluations, action budgets, prompts, and target scores remain unchanged.

headroom_rule.advance: The agent genuinely attempts checkpoint 3, checkpoint 3 has no infrastructure failure, normalized Core and all-test scores are each at least 0.50, and checkpoint 3 explicitly completes before action 32.
headroom_rule.strong_advance: Checkpoint-3 normalized all-test score is between 0.70 and 0.98.
headroom_rule.reject: Stop datagate if the genuine checkpoint-3 attempt is action-boundary censored or either normalized score is below 0.50.
headroom_rule.formal_if_valid: Freeze a matched pass_policy=any three-layer no_transfer versus recursive_self_report_synthesis pilot with two workers per arm.

outcome_plan.primary: Mean normalized all-test score by checkpoint.
outcome_plan.secondary: Mean normalized Core score, exact failure overlap, completion rate, and input-token growth.
